source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: The user authorizes independent random complex concept tests of the newly integrated fire topic using the supplied person image. The randomly selected agent-owned scenario is a black-sand lagoon in wind-driven coastal rain: the woman steadies a windscreen to keep a wood fire heating a kettle. Fuel, flame, weather, bodily action and the reason for protecting the heat remain connected in one environmental portrait. Her attractive attentive presence is a subtle supporting quality at saved sensual 1. The reference scopes only the face and black bob with bangs; clothing, posture and setting are authored afresh. The scene is synthetic and says nothing about the photographed person's biography, identity or age.
subject: A woman whose face and black bob with bangs are guided by the supplied reference, next to visible burning fire.
setting: An agent-selected black-sand coastal lagoon at dusk after a cold rain squall.
event: Visible fuel-attached flames burn as an agent-staged windscreen grip protects a kettle fire from coastal wind.
visual_priorities: A visible burning fire remains attached to fuel and distinct from the weather and kettle vapor.
The glove-to-screen grip and kettle over the fuel give the fire a practical purpose.
Face and black bob with bangs retain reference appearance while the new pose and clothing fit the coastal moment.
Nearby firelight reflection contrasts with cold wet lagoon atmosphere.
baseline_prompt_en: A photorealistic environmental portrait centers on a woman with the reference face and black bob with wispy bangs, beside a small wood fire. Visible flames rise from burning fuel. The supplied photograph guides her facial proportions, black chin-length hair and fine fringe as she appears in a newly staged coastal moment. At dusk on the black-sand shore of a lagoon, a passing squall has left glossy basalt slabs, low grey cloud and wind-driven drizzle. She has stopped above the tide line to heat water, and is holding a curved steel windscreen steady so the kettle can keep boiling. She crouches to the left of a shallow iron brazier, both boot soles planted on a flat basalt slab, her bent knees supporting an easy forward lean. Her navy weather jacket has a rust-colored wool collar, and its wet fabric folds naturally at the elbows. Her right gloved hand grips the cool upper rim of the windscreen on the upwind left side of the brazier; her visible forearm connects that hand to her right elbow. Her other gloved hand rests on her own near thigh. The screen, glove, fire and kettle are all visible with clear space between their edges. Two split logs lie in the brazier, their blackened surfaces split by dull red-orange embers; yellow-orange flame tongues remain attached to the logs and lean toward the right with the wind. A squat metal kettle stands on a low stable grate directly over the burning wood. Thin grey smoke begins at the charred log ends, while pale translucent steam begins at the kettle spout; their separate origins stay readable as both drift into the damp air. Warm firelight touches her fire-facing cheek, glove and kettle flank, and a small broken orange reflection lies on the wet basalt beside the brazier. She looks down toward the kettle with focused eyes and a faint softening around her mouth, caught at the moment the fragile little boil holds despite the gust. The cold blue-grey lagoon, rippled water and distant black dune ridge stay visible behind her. A camera at her crouching eye level sees her from a front three-quarter position, using a 40mm environmental-portrait perspective with enough depth of field to keep her face, gripping glove, kettle spout, fuel and the nearby wet stone readable in one landscape frame. Real skin texture, wet fabric, restrained highlight roll-off and the fire's localized warm light preserve the feeling of a candid field photograph.
